task: Tighten the CLI Analytics period-membership admission predicate in postgres/reader.py so lifecycle/housekeeping records and zero-value metric points no longer admit a session into a period window it had no real activity in.

key_reasoning.reason: The predicate (_SESSION_ADMITTED_IN_WINDOW/_active_in_window/_has_any_activity/_raw_activity_in_window) is a core shared utility read by the single 'sel' CTE that ~30 reader methods across all six dashboard endpoints (Overview, Sessions, Users, Repositories, Cost, Activity) depend on; the fix must be applied consistently across all 5 arms of _admitted_arms and may also touch rollups.py (lines_daily zero-value semantics) and session_activity.py (derived has_activity/resumed cache) — bumped per 'touches core shared utilities' red flag.

AC4 itself and the four required regression tests are well specified, but several design decisions remain open: whether to close the EPMCDME-16993 reopen gap (_has_any_activity arm) within this fix's scope, the exact narrowing definition for the four raw sources (usage_requests, log_events, spans, metric_points), whether session_activity.py's derived facts need to track the narrower rule, and the '/exit synthetic user_prompt' mechanism is explicitly unverified against this repository.

No exact precedent exists for narrowing these specific raw-activity clauses (though the vocabulary — EventKind.API_REQUEST, SpanKind.TOOL/TOOL_EXECUTION/INTERACTION — already exists); this exact code path has a documented, measured history of catastrophic scan-cost regressions at ~1.9M-session scale, carries zero semantic (row-admits-or-excludes) test coverage today (only SQL-string-shape assertions), and narrowing _has_any_activity risks regressing a documented sub-day started_at-precision guarantee.

Primary edit in reader.py; likely companion edits to test_reader.py (new semantic tests), optionally rollups.py and session_activity.py/test_session_activity.py, plus a doc update to cli-analytics-storage.md's Window Semantics section per established convention — roughly 5-7 modified files, 0-2 new (live-Postgres fixture/test), across the repository and tests directories.
No new packages or version changes; purely an internal SQL-predicate and test-infrastructure change.
Confined to the repository/adapter (DB-Persistence) layer; the CliAnalyticsReader port contract, routers, and services are explicitly unchanged.
